the FhuA‘’PhoA proteins are not properly integrated into the outer membrane and that the FhuB and FhuC proteins are not essential for FhuA‘’’PhoA export.
the FhuA‘’PhoA fusions were exported to the outer membrane, but were not properly integrated into it.

the export of the FhuA‘ fusion proteins across the cytoplamsic membrane, the proteolytic degradation of the fusion proteins, and the integration of the fusion proteins into the outer membrane.
the question of how proteins are exported across the cytoplamic membrane and the outer membrane of E. coli K12.

FhuA‘PhoA fusion protein are exported into the outer membrane of E. coli K12.

we can use the FhuA‘PhoA fusion to probe how proteins cross the outer membrane and how they are integrated into the outer membrane.
